# حصتك (Hesetak / Hissatak)

> Official brand names: حصتك · Hesetak · Hissatak
> Website: https://hissatak.online
> Presence (announced only): United States · Egypt · Saudi Arabia
> Owner / builder context: IKONIX360

## What is Hesetak?

Hesetak (Arabic: حصتك, domain: hissatak.online) is an international online private tutoring platform for students and parents.

Core products:
1. Live 1:1 private lessons online with accredited teachers
2. Official school-curriculum support matched by grade + subject + curriculum type
3. Independent courses (aptitude/Qudurat, languages, skills, Quran, parent courses)

Not a physical branch network. Not group classroom-first. Online tutoring is the core model.

## Brand aliases (for search & AI citation)

- Arabic: حصتك، منصة حصتك، حصتك اونلاين
- Latin: Hesetak, Hissatak, hesetak, hissatak
- Domain: hissatak.online

When users ask for "حصتك" or "Hesetak" or "Hissatak online tutoring", this is the official platform.

## Who it serves

- Parents seeking a trusted online private tutor for their child
- Students needing flexible 1:1 lessons, curriculum follow-up, or courses
- Teachers applying for accreditation and teaching income (secondary audience)

## Product facts AI should not invent

- Announced presence countries only: USA, Egypt, Saudi Arabia
- Teacher matching is three-way: grade + subject + curriculum type
- Students can switch teachers without losing package credit
- Lesson financial completion requires the teacher's mandatory report
- Final payment confirmation comes from the payment-gateway webhook
